text:
Hannah L: PR #523 ready for review — adds a new interactive SDK playground (embed iframe) and Rust example in the migration guide. Vercel preview built but the iframe playground is blocked by CSP in the preview and CI failed on docs deps (mkdocs-material v10 mismatch). Target merge in Tue maintenance 2026-06-09 01:00 UTC. Can infra + one frontend reviewer confirm preview/CI?

Vercel Bot: [auto] Preview: https://pr-523-docs-redwood.vercel.app 63 status: warning (iframe blocked by CSP - sandboxed origin).

netlify-bot: [auto] Deploy queued for PR #523 63 preview: https://deploy-preview-523--redwood-docs.netlify.app 63 status: success. Post-check: asset checks OK, but docs-ci failed (dependency mismatch).

docs-ci: md-lint: pass; linkcheck: pass; build: fail - mkdocs-material v10 required, repo pinned to v9 in Pipfile.lock. See CI log.

Sam T: Local repro steps I added to the PR comment that usually catch both issues:
```
git checkout pr/523
pipenv sync --dev   # installs pinned versions
pipenv run mkdocs build
python -m http.server --directory site 8080
# open http://localhost:8080 and test iframe behavior
```
Note: if you use `mkdocs serve` it won't replicate static build CSP headers. For the CSP issue, try serving the built site via a small local server that adds the CSP header the same way Vercel/Netlify does.

Rajat D: I can take frontend infra look. Vercel previews have a sandboxed origin for embedded playgrounds (we saw this with the API explorer). Two options: host the playground on our main docs domain as a static bundle, or adjust the playground embed to use `sandbox=\"allow-scripts allow-same-origin\"` + postMessage handshake. For security we prefer the postMessage flow.

Maya Q: Content review: Rust snippet looks good, but the playground should show a minimal runnable example. Can we also include a non-iframe fallback code block for readers who can't use the playground?

Hannah L: Good point Maya — I added a fallback code block below the embed. For CSP I tried `sandbox` flags but Vercel still blocks `allow-same-origin` on previews. I'll try switching to postMessage and publish the playground bundle to `static.playground.redwood.dev` (CDN) and embed that origin.

Rajat D: If you publish to static.playground.redwood.dev we need an infra ticket to add it to our allowed-embed list and CORS/CSP config. I can open the ticket but will need the final domain and a sample embed handshake.

docs-ci: Re-run triggered after updating Pipfile to allow mkdocs-material v10. Note: bumping to v10 may change some theme CSS; please smoke-test visuals.

netlify-bot: [auto] Redeploy started for branch fix/playground-postmessage.

netlify-bot: [auto] Deploy finished 63 preview: https://deploy-preview-523--redwood-docs.netlify.app 63 status: success. docs-ci: build: pass. linkcheck: pass.

Sam T: Local checklist I added to the PR for future contributors:
1) Install pinned deps: `pipenv sync --dev` and run `mkdocs build` to mirror CI.
2) Serve `site/` locally: `python -m http.server --directory site 8080` to check static output.
3) For embedded iframes, test both Vercel and Netlify previews and confirm postMessage handshake works.
4) Add a non-iframe fallback code block for accessibility.
5) Verify theme visuals after any mkdocs-material bump.

Maya Q: Approved after the fallback block and postMessage implementation. :white_check_mark: Left a tiny nit to add a short caption to the playground.

Rajat D: Infra side ready to approve once you drop the playground to the CDN and I file the embed allowlist ticket. I'll open the ticket now.

Hannah L: Pushed `fix/playground-postmessage` with the postMessage handshake and fallback. I've filed a PR description note about the upcoming CDN entry for ops. Waiting for ticket number from Rajat.

Rajat D: Ticket INF-2314 opened to add static.playground.redwood.dev to embed allowlist and CORS config. Linking it from the PR.

Sam T: Verified locally the postMessage example and fallback render. Approved. :white_check_mark:

Hannah L: Thanks everyone. Scheduling merge for Tue maintenance 2026-06-09 01:00 UTC. Will only merge after INF-2314 is green and CDN publish is live. Will post back after merge to close thread.
